title: Person with Grazing Horses in Field, 1965 Rural B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot photo stamped SEP 65 along the bottom margin, capturing a person standing amongst several horses in a grassy field. A rustic wooden post fence stretches along the left side, while trees outline the horizon. Long afternoon shadows stretch across the grass, depicting rural everyday life in mid-1960s America.
